timeline.event: Marketing email campaign delivers; traffic spike begins
Rate limiter enters fail-open mode; idempotency lookups begin returning misses
First duplicate webhook processed; first double-charge occurs
PagerDuty fires on Redis pool exhaustion; on-call paged
On-call correlates billing duplicates with Redis outage
Redis restarted; pool drains and reconnects
Duplicate webhook processing stops; no further double-charges
